title: Flame Lab
objectives: Name the three zones of a flame

stages.title: Secrets of the Flame
stages.narration: The Guardian Flame's core ember hides inside a candle flame. Map its zones to reach it!

steps.text: A single candle flame flickers before you.
Professor Blaze: 'It has three hidden zones.'
Spark Bot scans the flame's colours.

stages.title: Does It Burn With a Flame?
stages.prompt: Sort each fuel by whether it burns WITH a flame.
stages.note: Fuels that vaporise (wax, gas) burn with a flame; solids that don't vaporise just glow.

stages.title: The Zones of a Candle Flame
stages.prompt: Tap each zone to learn about it. Visit them all!

locations.label: Inner Zone
locations.info: Dark, coolest zone near the wick — unburnt wax vapour.

locations.label: Middle Zone
locations.info: Bright yellow luminous zone — gives most of the light.

locations.label: Outer Zone
locations.info: Pale blue, HOTTEST zone — complete burning with plenty of oxygen.

stages.title: Mini-Boss: Reach the Core Ember
stages.prompt: Score 80% to reach the ember in the flame!

questions.q: A flame is produced only when the substance burning is…
questions.explain: Only gases/vapours burn with a flame.
The outer zone has complete burning.

questions.q: The yellow middle zone gives mostly…

stages.title: Guardian Flame: Ember 5 Lit!
messages: 🏅 You earned the Flame Analyst badge
You mapped the flame and claimed its core ember!
